listing.name: Persona 3 Portable — P3P3DS (endercodezz)
listing.summary: The project reports an early playable New 3DS build at 28–30 FPS in the field and 16-25 FPS in battles. Sound and the opening movie are absent. Headless PC images do not establish a desktop player. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American ULUS10512 PSP game input.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate and build privately from source for the handheld target. Check the project’s guide for the required files, region and revision. This is not a native Windows download.

warnings: The project reports an early playable New 3DS build at 28–30 FPS in the field and 16-25 FPS in battles. Sound and the opening movie are absent. Headless PC images do not establish a desktop player.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
